instruction: A candid photograph, medium shot at eye-level, set against a plain light gray wall. On the left, the man with an afro in a white tank top (R1) stands in profile, holding a lipstick container in his left hand while carefully applying lipstick to the lips of the woman in a white lace wedding dress (R2) with his right hand. The woman (R2) stands on the right, facing slightly left with her head tilted up and lips parted, looking forward. The scene is illuminated by bright, even studio lighting, creating a clean and neutral atmosphere.

R1 is the active makeup applier while R2 is the recipient with lips parted
R1 uses his right hand to apply lipstick to R2 while holding the lipstick container in his left hand
R2 tilts her head up and presents her lips for R1's application
